name: helper-responsibility-groups
goal: Generic text helpers live in Strings; helper cards and breadcrumbs use each callable source category, independent of consumers

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Generic text exports are grouped by their owner module paths. Give each selected helper a revision-scoped source category, move generic implementations into Strings, preserve domain categories and public imports.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The shared category matrix only used one category per owning module. Extend it with a generic text helper inside an Orders owner; require its own catalog heading and breadcrumb at current/historical revisions. Check metadata and generated guidance too.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 23af23d71 fails Helper folder follows callable source at desktop, tablet and mobile. This test-only checkpoint also validates workload identifiers; the same command and fixtures are frozen for green.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Generic text implementations now live in Strings. Callable-source categories drive headings and breadcrumbs independently of module owners; public imports, authored examples and IDs remain stable. Shared Harness guidance includes the rule.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: cbd33bd97 passed the unchanged committed command: all 3 viewport cases, 6 Reports unit cases and 65 root cases. Git readback verified 90 decoded captures and 220 contextual measurements.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
